name: Document Viewer
description:
Preview PDFs, images, text, CSV, JSON, video and audio from a table, with a document list, search, thumbnails, zoom, download and print.

Source: any region source with one row per document. Map ID and File Name, then Content (BLOB) or URL. MIME Type, Size and Description are optional. PDF: drawn with PDF.js 6.4.299 (included): page navigation, thumbnails, text search with highlighting, selectable text, zoom (fit width, fit page, 100%), rotate. Images: zoom, pan and rotate. Text, CSV (as a table), JSON (formatted), XML, SQL, Markdown and log files: readable preview with search. Video and audio: played in the page. Other types (for example Office files): file card with a download button.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins by TechRevX.
